component.name: Blockwright
component.summary: Draw ANSI and IRC block art

description.p: Blockwright is an editor for ANSI art in CP437 block characters and for IRC colour art. It has half-block, shade and form brushes, layers, text faces and styles, a library of stamps, and generator layers that run scripts.

It reads and writes .ans with SAUCE, XBIN and BIN, exports IRC text within a line budget and checks a piece against lint rules. The blockwright-cli command renders, converts and checks pieces without a display.

Micron as a target for NomadNet pages: a Format > Target menu, a NomadNet View dock, Snap to Micron Colours and .mu files opened as documents. Palettes: draw a document in its own palette, swap presets, fit and remap colours. Library collections, an offline help window, shipped in every package, and a 16-colour IRC limit. Layer > Add Generator Layer adds the output of a generator program as a layer. Removed: File > Publish to Library and Send to WeeChat; File > Export IRC Text stays. On macOS the Layers dock shows every row's visibility and Alpha Lock boxes. Library fixes for the bundled library, the trash and non-ASCII file names on Windows. A Flatpak manifest.
Export to Micron for NomadNet pages, in the app and blockwright-cli. New samples 07, 08 and 09, and a new sample 02.
